title: Aircraft Fabrication and Assembly Technician

program.section_heading: Aircraft Fabrication and Assembly Technician AS
outcomes: Plan, design, and construct aircraft structures to industry standards using sheet metal and composites materials.

Analyze and evaluate critical aspects of the aerospace industry related to safe work practices, standards and tolerances, standard shop practices, proper use of tools, power equipment, and personal protective equipment.
Use, read, and interpret industry standard blueprints to construct aircraft components.
